_comment: Shrink-only baseline of pre-existing upward import edges under scripts/ci/module-map.json's layer order (see docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §7.6). An edge here is DEBT: it may only be removed once the real import is fixed, never added to grandfather a new violation. Each entry names why it exists today. Regenerated entries are hand-authored, not tool-generated (unlike config/write-ratchet-baseline.json) because each needs its own `why`.

edges.why: the scraper calls this shared validator/normalizer function inline mid-extraction (parsing dates, amounts, offering type) rather than as a separate post-extraction validation pass the module map assumes — moving it would mean splitting each scraper into extract-then-validate stages, a real refactor out of scope for this slice.
